prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1392; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, so you can just note that I'm the passenger in the vehicle.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: We were in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center. The driver was backing out of a space when another car came through the lane.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What happened next?

A: The impact was on the rear passenger side. It wasn't a huge crash, but my body jerked forward and then back against the seat. The driver hit the brakes hard and I felt my head snap.

Q: Did you feel any pain immediately afterward?

A: Not right away. Within an hour my neck was stiff and my lower back started aching. By the next morning it was hard to turn my head to check my blind spot.

Q: Have you sought medical care?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They examined me, took some X-rays, and diagnosed a neck and back strain. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to follow up with a physical therapist.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some general soreness from lifting boxes at work once in a while, but nothing I'd ever treated.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm still in pain and missing some work because of it. I'd like the claim to reflect that.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
